messages:
akshay_oncall: OK taking over primary for the next 8h. quick pre-handoff access check — can everyone confirm PagerDuty, AWS assume-role, and Grafana read access?

lina_sre: I can confirm PD primary for the rotation is set to @akshay_oncall. I just checked the rotation rules. :white_check_mark:

ben_platform: AWS SSO -> I can assume the `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InfraOncall` role. run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to sanity-check. If you need the temp creds today use the JIT flow.

maria_ops: Grafana: I shared the night-ops dashboard folder with the oncall group, but make sure you can access the `latency-overview` panel. sometimes org mapping causes "org not found" for new accounts.

akshay_oncall: trying Grafana now... access ok for dashboards, can view but not edit. Is that the intended permission?

maria_ops: yes viewer is fine for oncall. if you need edit to add annotations ping me, I can grant for the shift temporarily. :handshake:

jenna_support: incident-bot shows the last P2 (cdn latency spike) was mitigated, customer impact annotated as low. no unresolved escalations in PD for the last 2h. leaving a note in the ticket: "handoff - no active pages"

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P2 cdn-latency resolved at 2026-03-14T23:40Z. PagerDuty incidents: 0 open for priority >= P2.

akshay_oncall: good. quick check on aws keys and CLI: I don't have the long-lived keys, using SSO. anyone with IAM perms to confirm JIT role duration?

ben_platform: JIT sessions default to 8h for infra role, but if you need extension contact me or create a service request in the console. sample assume command we use:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InfraOncall --role-session-name akshay-shift
```
Then export the creds. If MFA required, SSO will handle it.

lina_sre: PD escalation: make sure you have the emergency key in 1Password (label: PD-Escalation-Key). If you don't, DM me, I can add you to the secrets group for the shift.

akshay_oncall: I can see PD escalation key. Also verifying Grafana alert mute policy — do we leave the redirect rules enabled for night?

maria_ops: yes redirects on. only disable if doing a maintenance window. leave annotations on the dashboard for any runbook steps you take. runbook quicklinks: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/ops/oncall-handoff and the specific runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks/cdn-latency 

akshay_oncall: copying runbook links. a couple of items to note: APAC coverage gap from 02:00-03:00 UTC next week — flagged in the rota. we might need a secondary swap. anyone available to swap into secondary for that hour?

ben_platform: I can cover the APAC hour if needed. would prefer to be secondary so latency alerts remain targeted.

lina_sre: adding a note: if you need to escalate to SRE lead, use the PD escalation policy and tag `#sre-oncall` in slack. escalation window for P1s is 15m.

akshay_oncall: thanks all. final checklist: PD primary set, AWS assume-role tested, Grafana viewer ok, runbooks bookmarked, PD escalation key present. I'll post a short handoff summary on the shift doc and mark myself primary in the rota. :rocket:

jenna_support: acked. leaving a short ticket note: "Akshay primary for night shift — verified access to PD/AWS/Grafana"

lina_sre: thumbs up. ping if anything crops up.

akshay_oncall: signing off from previous context, taking the bridge now.
